versions.content: Keyword 'epsilon' epsilon represents an implementation specific constant intended to support the comparison of float values. It represents the smallest increment which can be expressed by the given implementation. For example instead of comparing a float with zero, one should use abs(sysc(x)) < epsilon ? 0 : 1
